purpose: Fast approximate Boolean mesh for geometrically matched input/PLAXIS units. No repair or new dependency.
mapping_note: Values are zero-based B indexes in A order. Geological identities are inferred, not confirmed.
probe_build: Link tolerant_probe.cpp to woby_core, nlohmann_json, spdlog, and Manifold in a Release vs2026-vcpkg build.
timing_scope: buildDifferenceMesh including input reading, Boolean computation, topology checks, and output publication; excludes scene load and comparison input assembly.
tolerant-pairs.jsonl: Earlier isolated prototype, before the production checks and publication. Not the final application timing.
rebase-sweep-summaries: Exact intersection scans and rejected simplification experiments. Invalid experimental volumes are not valid measurement results.
penetration-depths.json: Pairwise plane-penetration heuristic only; not proof of a globally valid mesh or an error bound.
synthetic-blocker.json: Two rotated 3x4x5 boxes offset 0.1 along local x; expected A-only and B-only volumes are 2 each.
